artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters Leaving Sodom
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Anthonie van Blocklandt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.9 x 39.6 cm (13 3/8 x 15 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration with full-length figures of several individuals. The central figure is walking alongside another person with wings, possibly an angel, who holds a walking staff. The winged figure supports and guides the man with one hand on his shoulder. The man has facial hair, prominent cheekbones, long and somewhat unkempt hair, and is barefoot. His clothing is long and flowing, resembling a robe. The angel has curly hair, a calm expression, and wears a draped garment. Behind them, three more figures are gathered, also with wings and similar attire, engaged in an interaction. One of the figures gestures forward emphatically. The setting includes large, leafy trees and a walled cityscape or village in the far background. The artwork has a monochromatic tone with fine lines and shades that create a dramatic, classical scene.

artworks.title: The Wolf Hunt
artworks.artist: Willem van der Leeuw after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting party on horseback being attacked by wolves. The central focus is on two mounted figures, one charging with a spear against a wolf. The wolves are depicted snaring and biting at the horses' legs. The horses are rearing up in response to the attack. The background features clouds and sun rays, adding drama to the scene. The figures and animals are depicted in intricate detail, emphasizing the tension of the encounter. The scene captures a moment of confrontation between the hunters and the wolves.

artworks.title: Resting Cows
artworks.artist: Nicolaes Pietersz Berchem
artworks.description: The image features a group of cattle resting near a large tree and a fallen log. The landscape includes a mountainous scene in the distance with a small building visible to the right. The sky is expansive with textured clouds. The artwork is created using detailed etching techniques to portray the scene in a monochrome color palette with variations of gray and black. The composition highlights the cattle, foliage, and the peaceful countryside scenery.

artworks.title: Drunken Silenus
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows three people. In the center is an older man leaning forward with his eyes closed. A young man is on the left looking at the older man, while a young woman on the right supports his head. Another man behind the woman is pouring liquid from a jug into the older man's mouth. The background depicts tree branches with leaves and an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Virgin Supporting the Dead Christ
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a group of people surrounding a reclining man. The central figure is a bearded man with a bare torso, lying on a draped fabric. To his left is another figure kneeling, and next to them is an angel with large wings. To the right of the central figure, a woman sits, holding him with one arm and gesturing upward with the other. Behind the central figure, a young man with curly hair points towards him. The scene is set against a rocky background with clouds above.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on rocks, facing forward. He is holding a staff in his right hand, draped in a cloth around his waist that covers his left arm. His face has a beard and long wavy hair. Light radiates from his head, creating a halo effect. Nearby figures appear surprised or agitated, some looking up at him. The background includes clouds and trees, with small angelic figures in the clouds on the left. The scene is dynamic and detailed due to the engraving technique used.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural scene. The scene includes classical architectural structures with various decorative elements. In the center, there is a plaque with classical text. Above the plaque is a crest surrounded by garlands held by cherubic figures with wings. Large urns with foliage are positioned on either side of the central plaque. In the foreground, there is a decorative fountain with sculptures. Three figures in period clothing are gathered at the bottom, looking towards the central structure. The background features classical architectural buildings.

artworks.title: Dedication Page
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a scene depicting a coat of arms. The drawing features mythical creatures like mermen and mermaids gathered around a shield with heraldic symbols. Above them, a winged figure holds a banner with Latin text. The background includes wispy clouds and sea elements. The style of the artwork resembles classical engravings, emphasizing mythology and heraldry themes.

artworks.title: Escorial, Spain
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene from an elevated viewpoint. It depicts a courtyard surrounded by detailed buildings with no clear horizon separating the sky from the land. The artwork features intricate lines and cross-hatching for shading, creating a monochrome color palette of varying shades of brown to emphasize the stonework and architecture. Within the courtyard, elegantly dressed figures are dispersed, some engaged in conversation or movement. The background displays a cloudy sky, adding depth to the grand setting.

artworks.title: Palace, Florence
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural view from a slightly elevated angle. The scene is dominated by grand architectural structures extending into the distance, with a large, ornate building in the center and towards the right. The building features statues and arches and intricate architectural details. The architectural style is characterized by precise, linear brushstrokes, with a monochromatic color palette of brown and tan. Figures of people are depicted in motion, some engaged in conversation, while others are walking or at play. In the distance, more buildings are visible, suggesting a grand urban landscape.

artworks.title: Borghese Palace and Gardens
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural scene with a villa and surrounding garden area. The villa has an ornate façade with archways, columns, and decorative sculptures. There are two fountains in the foreground, one with a statue and another with troughs and seated figures. People are walking and interacting in the garden area. The depiction is detailed with fine lines creating texture in the foliage and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic with a range of sepia tones, giving the image an aged appearance.

artworks.title: Piazza di Spagna, Naples
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a lively scene captured from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is high with trees and buildings. The artwork uses detailed linework to create texture and depth, particularly in the clouds and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige. Various figures are engaged in a gathering, with a large ship, trees, and sculptures adding to the scene. Buildings in the distance frame the square below.

artworks.title: Villa Aquaviva
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden with tall, detailed trees framing the space. In the background is a grand house with a symmetrical facade, ornate windows, and a grand entrance. A pathway leads from the garden to the house with figures dressed elegantly and statues on pedestals. The painting is detailed, with a monochromatic color scheme of sepia and black.

artworks.title: Gardens of Prince Mattei, Rome
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: This image features a garden scene with statuary as the main subject. Large, overhanging tree branches fill the upper portion of the composition. Two pedestals holding statues flank a larger reclining figure on a tomb or sarcophagus in the center. The artwork shows intricate brushstrokes or etching techniques depicting detailed textures in the statues and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, primarily in shades of brown and ink, typical of etchings or engravings. Two human figures appear close to us, interacting with the statues, providing scale and adding life to the setting. The environment extends into the background.

artworks.title: Statues of Mercury and Flora, Gardens of Dukedi Sora, Frascati
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows statues on pedestals with dense foliage in the background. The foliage obscures the horizon line. The intricate detailing of the branches and leaves lends depth to the scene. The style features meticulous brushstrokes or etchings creating detailed textures in the statues and greenery. The color palette emphasizes shades of black and white. A figure in period attire is seen inspecting or admiring the garden's architecture. The wall is decorated with urns and balustrades.

artworks.title: Grotto, Monta Tragone
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a detailed architectural garden scene. The view is through a large archway, showcasing an ornate fountain or statue ensemble with classical figures and plant urns above. The scene expands to more architectural elements and greenery, with fluffy clouds in the sky. There are two figures in historical attire conversing near us.

artworks.title: Balpoggio, Villa of Duke di Ceri
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of a formal garden with statues. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the scene is framed by trees and foliage. There is a variety of classical statues placed along what could be considered a pathway or courtyard area, with two figures close to us in the scene. The artwork appears to be an etching, characterized by detailed linework and a monochromatic palette. The play of light and shadow adds depth and contrasts the sculptures with the surrounding greenery.

artworks.title: Palace and Canal, Cardinal di Ferrara, Tivoli
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a symmetrical view of an architectural scene, potentially a palace courtyard. The horizon line is not clearly visible as the structures dominate the visual field. Statues and potted plants can be seen along the balustrades of the architecture. The style of the image appears to be an etching or engraving, with precise lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochrome, using shades of sepia or similar tones. In the foreground, there is a couple with a small animal and another person climbing steps, while grand arches and statues can be seen in the distance. The sky above is filled with clouds, with detailed linework adding to the scene.

artworks.title: Garden, Duke d'Altems
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a garden of a grand building, seen from above. The horizon line is implied beyond the walls with an upper terrace, statues, and potted plants. In the foreground, people are gathered near a fountain with two dogs. The scene includes detailed engravings of the building's facade, vegetation, and sky with clouds. The palette is monochromatic, conveying textures and shadows.

artworks.title: Gardens of Cardinal Aldobrandini, Frascati
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a formal garden with a water feature. The viewpoint appears elevated, looking down into the garden enclosed by a decorated wall. The horizon is high in the image under a cloudy sky. The etching has detailed lines creating textures for foliage and masonry. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia. Statues on each side pour water into the central fountain, surrounded by trees and bushes. Tall trees are visible in the distant background.

artworks.title: Capitoline, Rome
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image features a detailed etching showing a view from a grand architectural setting. An elevated perspective reveals a square from a classical building, with a tree line, cloudy sky, and a distant ornate architectural structure visible in the background. Statues, including one of a figure on a horse, are displayed prominently to the right. The composition uses precise line work for shading, depth, and texture. The monochrome color palette contrasts dark lines with the lightness of the paper. Large columns frame the scene on the left.

artworks.title: Gardens, Duke d'Altems
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of an architectural garden. The horizon is in the upper third, marked by a row of trees. An ornate building is on the right, with detailed textures and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic in sepia or brown tones. Figures in period attire walk along pathways, with buildings and arches in the background. It is a detailed illustration of a formal garden and building.

artworks.title: Capitoline, Rome
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a grand architectural space. There is a large building to the left with classical columns, statues, and ornate details. The scene includes a plaza with people engaged in different activities, distant trees, arches, and smaller structures. The artwork is in an etching style, using fine lines and a monochromatic sepia color palette. The sky is filled with clouds, adding to the grandeur of the scene.

artworks.title: Gardens of Cardinal Coessi, Rome
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel after Johann Wilhelm Baur
artworks.description: The image shows a garden scene with a statue atop a fountain in the center. Surrounding the statue are water features and pathways. A grand building with ornate designs is visible on the right, and people are scattered throughout the garden. Large trees are in the center of the scene, and the sky is filled with structured, billowing clouds. The etching style includes detailed fine lines for texture and intricate designs on the buildings and sculptures. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of sepia or brown.
